definitions.direction: lexically sorted IPv4/port endpoints across all packets, independent of per-segment orientation
definitions.bidirectional_packets: at least one accepted labeled packet from each endpoint; not proof of application success
definitions.pure_syn_without_ack: every TCP packet in admitted group has exactly SYN and no payload
definitions.groups: connection groups for split isolation, not independent attacks or experiments
